ache.title: Prerelease hype: the excitement is the product
ache.note: This is Nero’s opinions on Zenless Zone Zero before it even came out. Pre-release buzz makes a game feel like something you can’t miss, and you start planning pulls for a game you haven’t played yet. Wait until you’ve actually touched it. Hype is borrowed excitement.
watch: planning to pull before you’ve played
launch buzz that feels like a deadline
ache.tip: Let launch week pass. Try the game free first and decide later, with your own opinion.
lines: hype is a loan. it comes due
you can arrive late. the game won’t mind
he was excited. that’s allowed. so is waiting
